verdict: Development challenges completed; independent evaluation remains pending. Candidate and check-strength evidence are separate.
inputReport:
Real Mosaic bug report (owner's application, commit 585a8a6 fixes it)

A user who signs in normally several times in a short period gets locked out with "Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in 15 minutes", even though every attempt used the correct password. Parallel test runs on one account hit the same lockout. Successful sign-ins should not use up the sign-in allowance; failed attempts should still lock the account after too many tries.

expectations.statement: A user who signs in with the correct password 15 times in a row is never refused.
After 15 failed sign-in attempts for an email, even the correct password is refused with the lockout message.

limitations: Development results are not independent evaluation.
Missing comparator roles are absent, not invented baselines.
Local execution is not a hostile-code sandbox.
Fault qualification assumes reviewed probe requirements correctly establish the declared violation.
